entries.title: Infinitary no longer pauses while a large program waits to start its next parts
entries.body: While a program with hundreds of parts had more waiting than it could run at once, Infinitary could pause for a tenth of a second or more each time anything changed. Starting a program's next part now takes a few milliseconds however many parts it has filed.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes; the window stops pausing, which a still picture cannot show.
